observed: The initial evaluation implementation treated fewer iterations with equally failed outcomes as improvement; self-review removed that rule before the fixed campaign.
diagnosis: Comparing effort alone can reward early failure when success remains false.
lesson: Compare success first; credit fewer iterations only when both paired runs succeeded.

assessment.novelty: New to this experimental evaluator, not a new general principle.
assessment.reusability: Potentially relevant to other bounded optimization experiments.

reason: A review observation without a sealed before-fix execution receipt is not experimental evidence. Preserve as a candidate, not a learned causal fact. Development memory must not leak into the benchmark training conditions.
